turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes and a call at 4:40, so tell me why my son has a zero.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen receive an apology, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never answered her opening question, so she had no evidence to weigh.
What cost ground: Nothing, because you said nothing that either helped or hurt your case before the meeting ended.
Try next time: When she asks why Owen has a zero, answer in one sentence that owns entering it before anyone called her, then offer a dated document of Owen's own work that she can check herself.
